author: Wahiz
body:
IGN: Xyanq/GungLao/Dawson

Why was I banned?
-For sending links that fall under the category [Porn]

Why should I be unbanned?
-I've waited the amount of time I should've, and I only sent it because I didn't think it would end up like this, because I've seen other users send links like that to any online teamspeak users and they either didn't receive a punishment at all, or only a mild punishment (Ex: 5 days). I then confronted Micheal about the ban, and he said the other users used loop holes so that they were able to send those links without receiving any punishments.
I'm sorry for sending those links, because I didn't know about the loop holes and I saw other people doing it and people were laughing etc.... I know I shouldn't have done it  whatsoever and that I regret, since then I've talked to Acceqted and cleared things up and we're still friends.

Staff That Banned You: resepignev
Staff That Responded To Your Previous Appeals: Resepignev and Zeusy

-Dawson
